unit.why: An anthology of quotations from Hasidic and kabbalistic books (Noam Elimelekh, Reshit Hokhmah, Beit Aharon, Me'or va-Shemesh) on prayer, stray thoughts, praying with the congregation and the force of the letters. It has no narrative events.
unit.boundary_note: The closing words 'מענין תשובה' are the heading of the next section, which begins in the next division.
